SD15-006.name: Angeloid
SD15-006.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Summon three Cost 3 or less "Divine Spirit" family Spirit cards from your Trash, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, that Spirit can't block.

SD15-007.name: Ascension Zero
SD15-007.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, when opposing Spirits become 0 BP, exhaust all Spirits which became 0 BP. Then, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -2000 BP.

SD15-008.name: Magical Draw
SD15-008.effect:
[Main]
Draw a card. Then, reveal five cards from your decktop, and add all Spirit cards with [Charge] among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the decktop in any order.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit -3000 BP.

SD15-003.name: The Angelia Archiel
SD15-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -1000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
During this turn, opposing Cost 3 or less Spirits can't attack.

SD15-004.name: The Angelia Axela
SD15-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -2000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit compares BP with an opposing Spirit that has a BP lower than this Spirit's, without comparing BP, treat the attack as not blocked.

SD15-002.name: The Angelia Machael
SD15-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Charge]
Your “BP- effect” decreases 1000 further.

[LV2]
When opposing Spirits are brought to 0 BP, exhaust all those Spirits that had their BP brought to 0.

SD15-005.name: The Angelia Plastiel
SD15-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Charge]
Your “BP- effect” decreases 1000 further.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
Your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing 4000 BP or less Spirits.

[LV3] (When Destroyed)
Return this Spirit to the Hand.

SD15-X01.name: The BattleAngelia Excel
SD15-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your Cost 3 or less Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, return them to your Hand. Then, draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's effect brings the BP of opposing Spirits to 0, destroy all those Spirits which had their BP brought to 0.
